0022600139.text: The Warriors (1-3, 12th in the West) visit the Timberwolves (3-1, 6th in the West) for Golden State's fifth game of the season, after a win in their most recent outing and a 1-2 road record. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Warriors lost the season series 1-3, including a 127-117 defeat in San Francisco on March 13, 2026.
